|translation='''Title:''' Grand Moff Tarkin.

'''Card text:''' If participating in the same battle as Vader, may cancel just one card after the enemy reveals it to determine destiny. A starship he pilots gets power +2.

'''Lore:''' Leader. Governor of the Outer Rim. Death Star commander. Played a part in dissolving the Imperial Senate. He was plotting to use the Death Star, which established the principle of rule through fear, in a rebellion against the Emperor.
|notes='''Grand Moff Tarkin (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Grand Moff Tarkin|Grand Moff Tarkin]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Grand Moff Tarkin (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R12 at rarity VR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R12.
